items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: they called Bailey, I played in his place about four or five nights in St. Louis

ctx.x: When I was over there, Louis Armstrong hadn't come there then. No. No, Louis Armstrong hadn't been there. If they tell you that night, I got around that cabaret and I wanted to leave. I wanted to leave Chicago. I wanted to come home. I didn't have no money. And I got around there and I started playing the Meala Dog Blues in that white cabaret. And I... stuff

picked up about five or six dollars around there and I got that little change and I hoboed my way had enough to buy enough food to come on down and I hoboed my way all the way from Chicago back here took me about six days to do it but I done it, I come on back I was in St. Louis I played I was playing the Beale Street Blues then when I was in I played the Beale Street Blues, I played the Yardin' Down Blues in St. Louis it was in old man's place that old gray man up there, they called Bailey, I played in his place…
